{{Top|leg}}
The '''Sith archives''' was a hidden storehouse of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] knowledge created after the establishment of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane's]] [[Order of the Sith Lords]]. Within the respository resided stories and legends of the most glorious [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]].

[[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] was known to have had access to the Archives and showed it to [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]. The [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] went through it for long hours before he came upon an overlooked entry of a Sith Lord thousands of years ago who wielded a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], which the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] would adopt as his weapon.

During his [[Sith training|training]], Darth Maul began a journal in the hope that his writings would be included within the contents of the Sith Archives.
